name: Tool Page & Comments Section
description: Component group comprising ToolPage.tsx (page-level orchestrator), CommentsSection.tsx (stateful Convex-backed comment list + form), and four pure presentational sub-components (StepBadge, VersionBadge, CodeBlock, VideoEmbed), plus two utility functions (formatRelativeTime, isToolSlug) and one derived lookup map (TOOL_MAP). ToolPage extracts toolSlug from React Router useParams, validates via isToolSlug type guard, performs O(1) lookup from TOOL_MAP, and renders decomposed props into sub-components. CommentsSection manages real-time comment query/mutation via Convex hooks and local form state with validation. All props interfaces use canonical registry types (ToolSlug, StepNumber, HexColor) without redefinition.

functions.name: ToolPage
functions.description: Page-level React functional component at src/pages/ToolPage.tsx. Extracts toolSlug from useParams, validates via isToolSlug type guard, performs O(1) lookup from TOOL_MAP. On valid slug: renders tool name heading (with accentColor inline style), one-line description, StepBadge, VersionBadge, mapped InstructionStepList as CodeBlock cards, conditional VideoEmbed, and CommentsSection. On invalid slug: renders not-found UI. No explicit props — route params are the implicit input.

error_cases.name: invalid_tool_slug
error_cases.condition: useParams().toolSlug fails isToolSlug type guard (not in ToolSlug enum)

error_data.behavior: Renders inline not-found message, does not throw or redirect

error_cases.name: missing_tool_slug_param
error_cases.condition: useParams() returns undefined for toolSlug (route misconfiguration)

error_data.behavior: Treats undefined as invalid slug, renders not-found UI

preconditions: Component is rendered within a React Router v6 <Route path='/tools/:toolSlug'> context so useParams provides toolSlug
TOOL_MAP is loaded and contains entries for all valid ToolSlug variants
Convex provider is present in the component tree (required by CommentsSection child)
postconditions: If toolSlug is a valid ToolSlug, renders complete tool page with heading, description, StepBadge, VersionBadge, instruction CodeBlocks, optional VideoEmbed, and CommentsSection
If toolSlug is not a valid ToolSlug, renders a not-found message without crashing
accentColor is applied via inline style to the heading element and propagated to StepBadge, VersionBadge, and CommentsSection
VideoEmbed is mounted if and only if toolDef.videoUrl is a non-empty string
CodeBlock components are rendered in instruction order with correct step titles and bash content

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render function. All side effects are delegated to CommentsSection child.

functions.name: CommentsSection
functions.description: Stateful React functional component at src/components/CommentsSection.tsx. Accepts page (ToolSlug) and accentColor props. Uses Convex useQuery(api.comments.listComments, { page }) for real-time comment subscription and useMutation(api.comments.addComment) for submissions. Manages CommentFormState via useState. Validates non-empty author and body on submit. Renders three states: loading spinner (query returns undefined), empty state message, and populated comment list with author, body, and relative timestamp via formatRelativeTime.

inputs.description: Tool slug identifying which page's comments to query and submit to.

inputs.name: accentColor
inputs.description: Accent color for the submit button background and section heading.

Falls back to absolute date for timestamps older than 30 days.

reads: PUBLIC:ToolDef static constants (tool names, descriptions, versions, instructions, videoUrls, accent colors)
PUBLIC:Comment list from Convex real-time query filtered by page slug (author display names, comment bodies, creation timestamps)
writes: PUBLIC:Comment documents to Convex via addComment mutation (page slug, author display name, comment body)
data_access.rationale: ToolPage reads static tool definition data (names, descriptions, versions, setup instructions, video URLs, accent colors) from an in-memory constants module for rendering tool documentation pages. CommentsSection reads comment documents from the Convex 'comments' table filtered by tool slug via real-time WebSocket subscription, displaying author names, comment bodies, and relative timestamps. On form submission, CommentsSection writes new comment documents containing the page slug, user-entered author name, and comment body text to the Convex 'comments' table. All data is PUBLIC classification — no PII, authentication tokens, or sensitive data is processed. Author names are user-chosen display names, not verified identities.

side_effects.rationale: CommentsSection subscribes to api.comments.listComments via Convex useQuery WebSocket to display a real-time comment feed for the current tool page.
CommentsSection invokes api.comments.addComment mutation to persist user-submitted comments. Fields are user-provided display name and free-text body, scoped to the current tool page.
VideoEmbed renders a YouTube iframe whose src is the tool's videoUrl. The browser fetches YouTube content directly; no application-level data is transmitted.
